tts: Why does the casino always win? It doesn't cheat. It just knows the math better than you do.
Take roulette. You bet on red, and it pays even money. But the wheel has thirty-seven pockets: eighteen red, eighteen black, and one green zero.
That one green zero is the whole business. On every dollar you bet, the casino keeps about two point seven cents.
You might get lucky for a night. But the casino takes millions of bets, and at that scale, luck turns into simple bookkeeping.
Slot machines are even better for them: on the Las Vegas Strip, they keep around seven and a half percent of everything played.
And a near miss, two cherries and the third one just off, lights up your brain almost like a win. So you spin again.
In nineteen thirteen, in Monte Carlo, black came up twenty-six times in a row. People piled onto red, sure it was due, and lost millions.
So the casino doesn't need to cheat. It just needs you to keep playing.
